text: This is Worship Studio — a complete planning and presentation tool built for church production and worship teams, from first draft to the moment you're live on stage.
Everything a service needs — songs, slides, media, and the people serving — lives in one place, synced across your whole team so everyone's always looking at the same plan.
The Services page shows what's coming up and what's already happened, and Plan Ahead lets you look weeks or months down the road.
Every service can start from a template or a blank page, and takes just a few clicks to set up.
Every song your team uses lives in a searchable library — lyrics, chord charts, and CCLI details, all in one place you build once.
Slides work the same way — build a deck from scripture, announcements, or custom content, and reuse it in any service.
Add background images and video to your Media Library, and they're available to every slide and every service.
Presentation Themes control how lyrics and media actually look on screen — fonts, colors, and layout — so everything matches your church's style.
Keep track of everyone who serves, with contact info and the roles each person can fill.
Roles group your team by what they do, which keeps scheduling and assignments organized week after week.
Announcements you want printed in the bulletin or shown on screen live in their own library too.
Service Templates capture your typical order of worship, so next week's service starts from a running head start, not a blank page.
Reports cover CCLI song-usage and multi-week planning, generated straight from your real service data.

Settings covers your library location and sync — your whole library lives as plain files in a folder you can sync with Dropbox, no server required — plus display setup and every other preference, all in one place.
Opening a service shows the full order of worship — drag in songs, slides, media, and announcements to build out the week.
Selecting any item previews exactly how it'll look live — full-screen lyrics and media, right here before you ever go on stage.
Assignments ties directly into People and Roles — see who's serving this week, and fill any open spot in seconds.
That's Worship Studio, start to finish — plan the service, build the library, and present it live, all from one app.
